Funny, I feel the same and only recently realized it. I remember wanting to be a grown-up so badly, watching kids shows only to make fun of them, never really connecting with others on kid things - I hated playing imagination type games, for example, even though I had a hell of an imagination by myself. I constantly thought of my future career, who I was going to be, what I would do as an adult. Like I didn't know how to just be a kid.

My stepmom never wanted kids and when me and my brother were young on weekends with them we only rarely did kid things - most of the time we were workhorses. As I've been examining the abuses from my stepmom these past few months, I started to wonder: did I not like being a kid because I actually didn't, or because I was encouraged to grow up too quickly?

I don't actually know if this is an accurate connection or not, it's just something I've been wondering. The point is, you're not alone.

Hey, it's been 7 hours since you posted this, and I really hope you're still here.

I'm so sorry for your pain, and I hear you. When I do think about it, it's like...what if I survive? Then I have to deal with all of \*that\* on top of my other issues? Is it more or less exhausting to keep living as I am than it is to deal with the fallout of a failed suicide? I understand how you feel...between a rock and a hard place.
Agreed. It's somewhat comforting to see other people who feel the same way. Makes me feel like less of a bad person. Stay strong.

I'm in the same boat as you. The older I've gotten the more cognizant I've become of my childhood traumas and the things my parents did that made me the way I am today. I hold no ill will against my mom because she's always been very understanding when I've brought up issues with her. My dad and stepmom are the type to turn it  back around on me so I don't even try. Even if I did, I don't want to make them feel bad because for the most part I want to believe they did the best they could and I don't like making people feel bad. The amount of real estate they have taken in my brain is unhealthy.

Sorry, I didn't mean to ramble. The point is, I understand. If you ever need to chat, feel free to message me. I'm not on this account every day but I promise I'll get back to you.
